_doc: Map 4 'Fernflug' Act IV: Mondlicht, the relay station (UPDATE 07, docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md §6, DECISIONS T-112/T-113). map_key: the story-prop / intel key. act: the act block (RoundManager: rounds are ACT IV · n from match round start_round = 30, named here so the act numbers right whatever is built before it; gravity_scale / slide_distance_mult / vacuum are the map-wide physics GameState.apply_act_physics reads; the boss is summoned when its zone opens, not on a round; the renewal fallback renews the plan at act round renewal_fallback_act_round if the Account was never opened). zones: vacuum = no air (the AIR gauge); roam = open ground. earth: the sky object. solar_flare: the special round. columns: the three retention columns and the sign. renewal: the bad ending's clock. endings: the runners' timings. No exfil: this act ends the campaign (cancel_ending / renewal_ending).
roster_doc: jumpjockey and backorder are Act III's types (the Groom Lake build defines them in enemies.json; this act lists them by id: enemies.json `maps` admits them here, max_active 4 / 3). suited and shield_cell are this act's.

spawn_table._doc: windows = the domes' service hatches (closets outside the hull); ground = emerge points (the regolith, the conveyor, the nave's floor); catwalk = the yard's two leap points (Catwalk_C_YARD_n) for the Jumpjockeys. The Account has no spawns: the horde comes through its one door and the Manager brings the crew through the pad.

solar_flare._doc: The special round: the air posts fail, the Earth flickers, the Suited come over the rim every interval_seconds in waves of per_wave while the queue lasts; the yard shut: Gängers through the fallback points of the open domes. The last wave's point takes the Resupply.

columns._doc: The three retention columns in the hall (RetentionColumn): read the terms plate (hold read_seconds; a Lodestone lift on the cap sets cap_lifted_N and the hold is lifted_read_seconds), the cap lifts, the lattice goes dark, a letter falls off NOBODY CANCELS, the Backorders wake. All three dark: flag account_open (the Account door). panels: which fine-print panel each plate quotes (the TERMS_READ_N category reads it aloud).

stages: N B D  C N  LS

renewal._doc: The bad ending's clock (renewal_ending.gd): starts at the Manager's RENEWAL phase, real seconds; warn_at are the Operator's warnings (seconds left); the plan also renews on its own at the act's renewal_fallback_act_round if the Account was never opened. The key turning (the cancel ending) stops it.

arrival._doc: What the Act III flags change on arrival: peg_delivered = no arrival grace and -20% Scrip (the program's men have the manifest); dee_cage_done = Dee's three fading radio lines over the first rounds.
